title: Second Highest Salary in SQL
question: Write an SQL query to find the second highest salary from Employee table
subject: Database Management Systems
keywords: second highest salary second highest salary in sql sql second highest salary
code:
-- Method 1: Using Subquery
SELECT MAX(salary) AS SecondHighestSalary
FROM Employee
WHERE salary < (SELECT MAX(salary) FROM Employee);

-- Method 2: Using LIMIT & OFFSET
SELECT DISTINCT salary AS SecondHighestSalary
FROM Employee
ORDER BY salary DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1;
explanation: Implementation of Second Highest Salary in SQL in SQL/PL-SQL.

title: INNER, LEFT, and RIGHT Joins in SQL
question: Write SQL queries showing department names along with employee count using LEFT and INNER JOIN
subject: Database Management Systems
keywords: joins in sql left join sql group by join sql
code:
-- Employee count per department
SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(e.emp_id) AS total_employees
FROM Department d
LEFT JOIN Employee e ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id
GROUP BY d.dept_id, d.dept_name
ORDER BY total_employees DESC;
explanation: Implementation of INNER, LEFT, and RIGHT Joins in SQL in SQL/PL-SQL.

title: PL/SQL Trigger for Audit Logging
question: Create a BEFORE UPDATE trigger on Employee table to log previous salary into Audit_Log table
subject: Database Management Systems
keywords: plsql trigger trigger in plsql audit trigger plsql
code:
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_audit_salary
BEFORE UPDATE OF salary ON Employee
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO Audit_Log (emp_id, old_salary, new_salary, change_date)
    VALUES (:OLD.emp_id, :OLD.salary, :NEW.salary, SYSDATE);
END;
/
explanation: Implementation of PL/SQL Trigger for Audit Logging in SQL/PL-SQL.
